steps.name: Theodore's Call
steps.objective: Go to [Theodore] in the “Central Guild City of Esnil”.

steps.name: Heir of Jisk Estate
steps.objective: Go to [Yuran] at the “Luman Union Headquarters”.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It came sooner than expected. I don’t know if it was something that interrupted my rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t think I should rest for a long time. I’m worried for no reason….)

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I saw you go see Dana, but it's nice to talk to her properly. This is my first time seeing the ‘hero’ who saved the world… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not enough to hear those words yet.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Hehe, what is it? You can brag about that. Isn't the title of hero better than the goddess's motherfucker?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Now, let me formally introduce myself.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: My name is Theodore. I once taught students at the Imperial Academy. I'm retired now... .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I've talked to Dana, so I might know.  I also taught Sister Dana.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means the imperial family… .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Hehe, you know a lot. However, it would be best not to talk much about the sisters, including Dana.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It won't be good for you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying it could become dangerous?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: No, it would be incredibly annoying. As you probably know, anything related to the empire is usually a hassle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see, professor.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It's okay to be called professor. You can call me Theo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Theo. Then please tell me why you called me.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It's late because we were talking about this and that. Do you know the story of Jisk's territory in Eastland?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure. Please explain.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Yeah. While looking into the history of Eastland for the Kingdom of Morse, I came across an interesting piece.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: In ancient times, when the gods fought against the devil. In Eastland, the land itself almost disappeared when a god fell to the ground.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Coincidentally, around the same time, a huge meteorite fell from the sky, bringing Eastland to the brink of extinction.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Fortunately, it was revived by some force, but its natural state has changed a lot. In some places, all the land is red, and in some places, strange plants grow... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s the story of Goddess Gaia….)

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: The meteorite may have been Eastland's curse, but it was also a blessing. The meteorite contained a mysterious mineral called meteorite.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: The power of Uncheol led the civilization of Eastland... . And it also brought about the rise and fall of many countries. Weapons, magic tools, etc. became the cornerstone for war and conflict.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Still, the site where the meteorite was located was owned by the Jisk family, a noble family of the Kingdom of Howl, and indiscriminate mining was prohibited. Only use it to create minimal tools for the residents and the kingdom.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: However, the Deimos Church attacked the Kingdom of Howl, and as the kingdom disappeared, it became the property of the Holy Kingdom of Darkness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The way you talk about that place makes me feel like I should go there.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Yes, that's right. The heir of Jisk's territory has called you. I heard there was something I could give you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute, the heir is still alive? I heard that the Dark War was several hundred years ago.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: You probably know this person too. Hmm, Jisk Territory is now the land of the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos, but I heard that some places can be accessed from the Union of Light.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By any chance, are you GIS CARD? The name is similar to Jisk’s territory… .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I know it well. Sir Giscard is right. Since I'm done talking with Dana, I think I can go and meet him.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: First, go to Luman and check.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (First, I have to go to Yuran and ask him. But what is it that the Geomshin is giving me?)

steps.name: Meeting with GIS Card
steps.objective: Go to [Jis Card] at the “Jisk Territory Entrance”.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: So, let’s deal with what Master said, and the rest… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel it every time, but it always seems busy.)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You are here. sorry. I realized late that you were here because there was a lot of work to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. By the way, where is JIS CARD? I heard you called me... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You were inside the Federation Headquarters just a moment ago... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you not there now?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He's not here, but he's probably waiting.  You can go there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I get to Jisk Manor? Because I don't know... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Zysk's estate is located near White Coal Canyon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I think about it, it was closer than I thought?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes, that's right. It was under the control of the Deimos Church, so a long time ago, Master sealed the entrance with the help of the Jude Kingdom.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: In order to prevent the Deimos Church from crossing the Jisk territory and reaching White Call Canyon... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jiscard is now at the entrance. Does that mean the seal on the entrance has been lifted?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Master destroyed the seal with his sword.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… , that means… .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Currently, there appears to be no trace of the Deimos Church there.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I don't know the details, but it seems there is currently no trace of the Deimos Church there.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Obviously, the center of the continent is the territory of the Deimos Church and the Holy Kingdom of Darkness. Overall, the number of fanatics and stayers is said to be decreasing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is that so?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm guessing it might have something to do with what Vice does.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'll find out more about this later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand. So where exactly is the entrance?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It is the innermost part of the jewel tree forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There you are. I passed by it a few times... . Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything else you can say?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Iris believes in Adventurer and is waiting for the day to be fully with Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Please come back safely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Yuran… .

steps.name: flame of truth
steps.objective: Defeat [Wild Ayrgia] and [Hunter Makai] in “Zisk Territory” and report to [Xena] in “Zisk Territory”.

lines.text: (A new place entered through the inside of White Coal Canyon. It felt full of ominousness, but it soon disappeared, perhaps due to the energy radiating from a middle-aged man.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Jiscard… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Are you feeding the animals?)
(The animals in front of the GIS card run away when Adventurer appears.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Ah, it's you. %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Jiscard. I heard you called me.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Okay, thanks for coming. Anyway, it's a shame they didn't finish their meal. I'll have to call you again when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The animals ran away because of me, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It's okay. Oh, thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What did I… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thanks to you, one evil has disappeared from Eastland. The Mosse Kingdom and the fake Agashuras who controlled it... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You must have seen the end of someone named Ban. I felt his energy ‘transferring’ to another world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You felt it… . Shinik and Mediah also said the same thing before... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Actually, I don't want to feel it either, but since I am in a superhuman position, I have no choice but to feel it.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You may know this, but the power possessed by superhumans is part of the power of God... . I can't say exactly what kind of divine power it is, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Same as what Vice said...)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Eastland, influenced by the ancient gods who stayed in Crete... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I hope that no one can gain this power other than the seven so-called superhumans.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: As the leader of the Alliance of Light, I have one request for you. This work is also for Miss Iris.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Because I know you definitely won't refuse... . I'm so sorry.
(A familiar black-haired girl is walking from afar.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You came.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Master, I have come. And %s… , This is my first time seeing it since then.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Did Master call this person?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes, the reason I called you here is because I have some work to do to help this person.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Before you do that, El, be polite to %s. You are a hero who is providing a lot of help to the Union of Light and the continent.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I will listen to what Master says.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just take it easy. Just like before, just like wool.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Ah, just like before, just like wool… … .
(L's expression hardens and relaxes for a moment. It feels like how dare you compare me and Wool...)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: No. This is the will of the Master, and since he is for everyone, I will do my best to be polite.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will treat L as is.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Now, let me tell you what to do here.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I'd like you to recognize traces of the relic. God's relic... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A relic? I thought the relics of the gods were only found in Freios... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: There is more unknown than what you know. There may be things that are hidden and unknown... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: That relic is the ‘Flame of Truth’. It is said that the truth about those who pray in front of the flame will be revealed.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Those who learned the truth saved the continent several times, and sometimes put it in danger. Because of that risk, the Kingdom of Howl chose a sacred place to store it.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: That place is Jisk territory where the Star of Nothingness remains... , it's here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Star of nothingness... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: In ancient times, the world was shaken by the battle between God and the Demon King. In the aftermath, a star from the sky fell here. That is the meteorite called the Star of Nothingness... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Agni, the sun god, held on to the star to prevent it from falling, but it ended up falling with it... There is a story like this, but it is not accurate.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Anyway, the continent that was on the verge of extinction came to have many strange climates. The area where the meteorite fell was devastated, but over time, the meteorite helped us.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: A special metal, meteorite, from meteorites developed the civilizations of Eastland and the Kingdom of Howl. However, those meteorite-based technologies led to the death of many lives.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: This continent, with its history of struggle, had no choice.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: The explanation was long. So, I want you to find the ‘spark of truth’. It seems to be somewhere in the territory... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Can’t you feel a strange force somewhere?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, there's definitely something in there.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I feel its power, but I can't seem to find it. If it's not me, it's probably the same for others. So I called you because I thought you were the right person.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I thought you could find it if you were mentally connected to Miss Iris, who was in the position of the Star God.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Find it for me. If that's the case, the Union of Light can figure out what to do for Eastland... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I'm sure you'll know what you want to know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What I want to know….)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You look like you have made up your mind. Iris I hope you will, too, and have given your permission. Come with El.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris is also like that... . Then I will come back.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: There seems to be a suspicious energy at the center of the territory, so check there first. Please be careful.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'll be back. Master.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then shall we go….)

steps.name: ghost jenna
steps.objective: In "Zisk Territory", defeat [Zisk Territory Algoa] and [Carrier Phonos] and report to [Xena].

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: It’s been a while since I met you♪

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Monsters are only occasionally seen, but there doesn't seem to be any major problems. no… , it's the same. sorry. I'm not used to it yet... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. You will gradually get used to it. But who is singing?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: After all, I won’t be able to see myself to these people♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, who are you?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Yes? As you know, I am... .

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Huh? Can you see me? Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm just saying I can see it because I can see it, but if you ask me how it looks... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Who are you talking to right now? . Hey, is there really a ghost?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, L can’t see it? The girl here... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Wrong. So, let's stop. Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: L also has something to be afraid of. The blurry toes of the girl here make her look like a ghost... .

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Hehe, you are quite mischievous.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: That, stop!! Well, I'll be resting over there for a bit, so please call me when you're done chatting with the ghost.
(L seems to be pretending to be okay, but steps back with a slightly frightened expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I didn't mean to make fun of you... , who are you by the way?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: The introduction is late. My name is Jenna, Jenna Zisk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jenna, that’s a pretty name. nice to meet you I am %s… , please feel free to call me.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: %s… , it's a good name.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank goodness. I can meet someone here who can see me... . Now that I have someone who can listen to my story... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Sometimes people walk by, but they always pass by because they don't see me... . You seem to have no objection to what I see. Don't be embarrassed... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I happened to… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, wait, Zisk? Jisk? I heard that this is Jisk territory. Ah, then… .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: That's right. I am the daughter of my father, the owner and lord of this land. People called her daughter because she was the lord's child.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: My brother is a person who people around the world call Geomshin. You really like animals.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that means... . Well, I guess I need to explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly explain what happened to Jenna.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: You were able to see me because I was the goddess' errand boy. And he came here at his brother's request... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Hey, %s… . Sorry for the conversation, but it looks like a monster is coming this way, so I think I need to sort things out.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Oh, shall we talk about it in a moment? Then, please come back. Don't worry about me. Because no one can hurt me.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: And please be careful. I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, of course. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: … Ugh, uh… . Let’s get back quickly… . Ugh… . But where is the ghost?

steps.name: Jenna's Gift
steps.objective: Defeat monsters in “Zisk Territory” to obtain <Zisk Chrysanthemum>. And report it to [Jiscard].

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'm glad you weren't hurt.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I will listen to what you two have to say for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, L. ghost… No, Jenna seems a little disappointed... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Ugh… . You are there, right? I'm fine, so please talk to %s.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes, thank you. Then Adventurer. Can I start the story?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please speak.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I've been waiting for someone to see me here for a long time.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'm not sure exactly when. How much more than 400 years have passed... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was a long time ago... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I heard that a big war broke out on the continent. To be more precise, it would be better to say that I found out about it naturally.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: A war waged by the Deimos Church to seize supremacy over the continent... . To set the stage for that war, the Deimos Church first attacked our territory.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The Kingdom of Howl and the Jisk Territory were thought to have defended themselves against the Church's attack to some extent, but it only took a moment for them to collapse.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The fanatics killed all life in sight, and my brother and I tried to escape somehow... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Stop right before exiting White Coal Canyon... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Even though I look like this, I'm still glad that my brother is alive. And you are on a path that works for everyone... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jenna… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jiscard, don’t you know Jenna’s condition right now?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The seal on the entrance was recently lifted and he came nearby, but he didn't seem to notice the presence of a ghost.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: My brother can't come in here, and I can't even go to the entrance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see… .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I think the only person I can see is Adventurer. Even if fanatics come here from the north, they only pass by.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I wondered why there were fanatics, and it turned out that the entrance wasn't just on the side of White Call Canyon. It's towards the dark kingdom of Deimos.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes, that's right. I don't know why I woke up as a ghost and with memories of when I died.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: And you can't leave the territory. There must be a reason, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, I guess I should tell Jiscard first... .. Maybe I can find a way to find out why.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Not being able to leave the territory is like meeting a minuet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think you're not far from here, so I'll come right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much. He said he was Jenna's older brother. I don't think it's a coincidence that Jenna appears to me.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Adventurer, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Can you get a flower that blooms in Jisk's territory and give it to your brother? It's a white chrysanthemum.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will come back then. L, please wait here for a moment.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Yes. yes?! yes?! yes yes?! Please leave me alone... … .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Ahaha… . Don't be too scared. Should I sing you a fun song? .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I was a little surprised to feel your energy coming back... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Okay, tell me. What happened in the center of the territory... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know if you believe it or not... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He tells the story of meeting the ghost of Jenna, Giscard's younger sister, a girl on one side of the estate.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Hey, what did you say just now? Jenna? Jenna is there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And he asked me to get this and give it to him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Give flowers to Jiscard as Jenna requested.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Jenna, Jenna remembered this flower... . It was a flower that could be easily found in the estate, but now it is hard to find... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Jenna loved the decorations she made with these flowers... .
(Jiscard’s eyes are shaking violently.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jiscard… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yeah. Everything you said is true. I was trying to escape from the Deimos cult together with my sister Xena.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Our parents told us to go out, at least the two of us, to protect the territory according to the will of the lord.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I came this far with Jenna believing that everything would be okay. I was confident in my sword. but… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I thought I could protect Jenna. Because I believed that too. However, all of this was my arrogance in taking the sword lightly.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Xena collapses bleeding due to the cultist's attack, and I... . I couldn't do anything... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I'm sorry. I got emotional for a moment... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. I just... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Nope. I suddenly remembered a time I had forgotten... . I'm more sorry.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I buried Xena here. And, unable to control his vengeance, he began to search for and cut down the cult's fanatics.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: People didn't know about that day and just followed it, hoping for a bright future for the continent. When people called me a swordsman, I felt like I had been hit.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: … I realized I was wrong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, are they the Union of Light people?)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: So I do it for them, for the continent... . And I realized that I had to use the sword again for the sake of Jenna, my family, and all the lives that were sacrificed.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It's a long story. I'm sorry. But, that… . I don't know why only you can see Jenna's ghost.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It feels like I'm being influenced by something... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: If I find the relic, I'll use the opportunity to find out the truth... . I don't know how many times I've had that opportunity... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, so what should I tell Jenna?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Tell them you'll find out when you find the relic... . I want to go inside too, but... , I can’t go in… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, is that so… ? Then I will continue to look for El and the artifact.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thank you. For not asking any more questions... .

steps.name: where there is doubt
steps.objective: Go to [El] in front of the “Star of Nothingness” in “Jisk Territory.”

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: When and where will you come? The time I'm waiting for♬

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: … Uh, uh… . There's a gloomy energy somewhere... . It's like a ghost is singing.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: … El, that is actually correct.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: %s, you are here. I waited.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I have been there. L, I'm sorry. I've been left alone for a long time.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: No. I'll take a quick look around and then we can talk. It won't take long.
(L leaves quickly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Looks like L had a hard time waiting. Oh, Jenna. I went to Jis Card.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: What does your brother say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, what did you say… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I relay the story I shared with Jiscard to Jenna.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: You said so. I will help if I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, do you know what it is called ‘Flame of Truth’?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I don't know, but I know a little bit about what it's like because I heard it from my parents. But I don't know where it is.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Still, you can be suspicious. The star of nothingness over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Star of nothingness... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The local residents considered the meteorite sacred, saying that the energy of the star would benefit people. I also sometimes went in front of him and prayed.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The meteorite that came out of the meteorite also made everyone rich. After the Deimos Church took over this place, all the cloud metal collected went somewhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is the Deimos Church for…? .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: … Please go there once. The Star of Nothingness is located in the very innermost part of Jisk territory.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like some kind of power is still left there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t think it has the ominous or demonic energy that Weiss gave me…)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: %s, there is something you need to check. A place where suspicious beings and monsters gather... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this the direction of the meteorite you see over there?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: That's right. It seems that beings from there are filling the Jisk territory... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to go there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jenna, I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes, I hope you find the answer you want.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: … He's still there... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes, I'm right next to L right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, should I tell L this?...)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Let's go, %s. First, go in front of it and check the situation before making your move.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

steps.name: snake shadow
steps.objective: Defeat [Snake Shadow] in “Star of Nothingness” and report to [El] in “Jisk Territory.”

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: This terrible energy... , it is not from the Deimos Church that I know of. No, I think there's something mixed up... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel that way too. There's definitely something inside the meteorite.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: It seems like it will take a long time to deal with the alien beings coming out of here and even get inside.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: So while I cut down the beings coming out, I would like %s to go inside and check for any signs of ominous energy or relics.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I go?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: %s is not only recognized by Master, but also because you can do what I cannot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have I also been recognized by L?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I have nothing but respect for talented people in any field.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Ghost… Just don't make fun of me for being afraid of the same thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've never made fun of you. Hehe… .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Now, hurry up. This is enough for chatting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Yes, I will move right away too.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: This is Master’s hometown… .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Let's finish the work here perfectly for the sake of my brother and the teacher who took me away and then return.
(In the deepest part of the planet of nothingness, a suspicious energy is felt.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where am I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wandered around and ended up inside, but that thing I see over there... .
(A snake-shaped being with a suspicious energy is staring at you.)
They managed to find where I was, they were waiting for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what is it? Is it a snake? No, I don't think it's a regular snake. I'm speaking human language... .
Suddenly, I remember what he said to people like you.
It's a huge hindrance to your work! If you don't deal with it there, you'll regret it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean? Who are you?
Even though I am not him, I am his shadow… . me? Let's call it snake shadow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Snake? Snake shadow? What is that?

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: He looks like he has no idea. If so, let me tell you.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: If it were not you, but another person with a soul like yours, you would definitely understand this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I suddenly feel a chill coming from the snake shadow’s words.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A soul like me? What is that? however… .

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Even though I don't understand it, I feel it instinctively.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: I will show you who my essence is and what his will says.
(Suddenly the snake shadow gets sick of its appetite.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Now that I'm awake, I can't go against his will. So I will swallow you clean.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: It is my job to destroy those who stand in the way of his will.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: However, with the power you have, I may also be able to escape his will... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's noisy. This guy and that guy, power, power, power... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you want power like that, deal with it properly. I don't know who he is, but I will break his will.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: You are looking for the truth. If you can't handle the truth, it's wiser to just be swallowed.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: You can't stop the will from being activated just because you don't want it. Because I and he want it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will make you regret those words. Because I’m going to stop that ‘will’ right here and now.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: If possible.
(No sooner has the snake shadow finished speaking than it opens its mouth wide, exposing its huge fangs.)

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Big, big... .

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: This can't be... . His will could be pushed aside by a mere human... .

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: No matter how much of a shadow I am... .
(The movement of the snake's shadow becomes slower. Then, the image gradually begins to blur.)

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: He no longer allows my presence... .

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: … Am I going to disappear like this?

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Just because I, who had lived to protect his will for a long time, was pushed aside by humans... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The man you spoke of doesn't seem to think you are important.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Maybe your will momentarily surpassed his... . Yeah, you were no ordinary human.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe so. I've already been through too much to be considered a normal human being.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: I don't think that's the case... .

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: You really don't know yourself. Although it suits humans well to follow the path to oblivion without knowing the truth... .

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Those who went from humans to gods also don't know many things. If you want to know... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean? say!!

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Let me see the truth that God does not know where I am gone. She will give you the wisest answer.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Ouroboros. How can I be like this... . this… .
(The snake's shadow disappears and is no longer visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me, I didn't even get a proper answer. What on earth is going on... .
(An illusion of Iris appears before %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, sorry for appearing so suddenly… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The snake shadow told me to look at the spot where it disappeared... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's it over there... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah… , but do you see something?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I guess it's something only I can see. Only my eyes can see... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Well then, I'll take a quick look and tell you.
(The illusion of Iris stares at the spot where the snake shadow disappeared.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, unorganized memories from other places that I have not experienced come to mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What Iris is seeing is also what I am seeing now….)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Who is it?
(Suddenly, the image of another woman comes to mind.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I am Nii. Guardian of Luminous City... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is the woman I saw in Yggdrasil, but she seems like a different person. Is she a different being?)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: The people of Luminous City do not yet know of its existence, but soon Luminous will also become a part of this world.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: As long as we remain here to prevent the collapse of this world, you are the only one who can pursue Ouroboros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…Odin is not the same Odin he was back then….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's clear that he's talking to me. But, I don't remember them... He's talking to someone else, so why does it sound like this?)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: This is not the time to talk about such things. The child who was captured by Ouroboros... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Who is this girl...?)
Beyond time, to the world of the past... . My lovely, destined child... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel an unknown pain... Ugh... That person is similar to the Emperor Jiendia I saw in Dragon Emperor Castle...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems like a woman that Iris and I were looking at suddenly made eye contact. Could it be because of my mood?)
You're looking at me now, Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You….)
Iris… . A world without pain and sadness was created just as Iris wanted.
You, whom Ceres loves, this place, created by your will, is a very happy place.
However, Ouroboros woke up after misunderstanding the meaning of Iris. I'm trying to create a world without everything.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I knew it, but… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It was because of me. I… . I… .
Iris, it's not your fault. It's the fault of those who bully you.
Now trying to eat your world... .
Just as Odin and Nii have protected it from the past to the present, both Iris and %s can do it.
It's never your fault. You will become a great god... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, you… .
We'll be able to meet someday. First, let me ask you about Iris.
(With those words, the figures that appeared in front gradually disappear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, are you okay? That's not Iris's fault.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: A being who woke up in a world I created... , Ouroboros… .
(Iris looks shocked.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Ah, Iris? Iris, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Iris?
(Iris's appearance does not move as if it has stopped and then suddenly disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? Where have you gone? Huh… .. what? How does this feel?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, everything in front of my vision becomes distorted. A black chasm opens and begins to suck everyone in.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … This, this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, the scene in Moros where Van disappears comes to mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh no!! We have to get out of here!!

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: The monsters disappeared, like an illusion... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... . I barely got out.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: %s, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: L, I'm fine. Are you okay too?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: It’s okay… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… . Let’s take a moment to take a breath and talk. So what happened... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell El briefly what happened on the planet of nothingness.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: … Something like that happened. What on earth is that entity that made it here? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know either. Other than just Ouroboros... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: The fact that monsters, demons, and other enemies that came out from the Star of Nothingness disappeared like illusions was probably due to the influence of that existence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go back to Jenna first. We haven't found out anything here, but Jenna must know something.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Then let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth is going on...?)

steps.name: Forgetting and Truth (1)
steps.objective: Defeat [Lethe of Oblivion] at “Lake of Oblivion” and obtain <Flame of Truth>. And 'Report to [Xena] in "Jisk Territory".

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: To wipe away the flowing tears. The wind comes out and passes by you♪

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The back part rarely comes to mind. What was it called?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was a good song. Jenna.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you. I'm not good at it, but I like humming like this.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Yu, the ghost sang a song. I feel like I can hear it somehow... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I see that you have not found the spark of truth when you come back to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, are there any more places worth visiting?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: It's a place worth visiting... Hey, Adventurer… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Are you not feeling something right now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well… . Oh, do you mean Iris?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Iris… ? Ah, that is the name of the God you spoke of when you came here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Iris. However, Iris is not here. It came for a moment and then disappeared. It's a bit complicated... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: So what I felt was… .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Maybe there is a god-level being here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As soon as Jenna finishes speaking, a chill is felt around her.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: … Hey, who are you?
(At Jenna’s question, the surrounding air becomes cold. El’s figure, which was moving just a moment ago, freezes.)
You got caught. I just approached you because I wanted to hear your story.
(A woman's voice is heard from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I know myself… This feeling is the same sacredness as when I met Gaia… But, something is different. It feels like it has been slightly altered…)
Do you have any intention of returning empty-handed?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if you don't want to do that?
Hehe, then shall we talk for a moment?
(No sooner has he finished speaking than the world is suddenly filled with an ominous feeling.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Here… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It feels similar to the space someone forcibly took me to in the past….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (However, it seems that the Jisk territory just became dark.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come out now.

choices.text: 1. I heard there was something to talk about.

lines.text: That's cool.
(A red flame rises brightly in the darkness. Then, the figure of a woman appears.)
I hoped no one would come this far.
(A red flame is burning at the tip of the woman's finger.)
But then you came here. And touching his shadow... .
(Then, a blue flame burns in the woman's other hand. Two flames with different colors...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could it be that….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you want to say? So who are you?
I am Lethe.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: They were afraid of my power and kept me from coming to Etoire, and now they are not there.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: They needed my power, so they just showed it to me, but they banished me. Here in this world I love... .

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Those who are afraid of the truth while only disappearing... .

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: You have the blessings of the children who were with them.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: If children love humans this much... .

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Poor Ceres who was used by them and Gaia who was abandoned... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means you are a god.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: God… , that is just a name given by the life that followed those with power.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Let me say it one more time. Now go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If your power is truth, please help me know the truth for the world you love.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: I think this is the first time I’ve seen someone ask for a favor.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Girl there. You know it too. What kind of being am I? And what do I want to know from this great being... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Why am I here? I'm sure he died... .

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Girl and Adventurer, are you confident enough to handle the truth?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to know. Even for everyone... , even for Iris.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Being for everyone is a definite lie that humans tell... .  A girl who is a descendant of humans created by Ceres and has not yet become a proper god... .

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: I wonder if it would be possible to not reject someone even if they knew the truth. God and man, they just want power. Without even accepting the truth!!
(Lethe's voice becomes louder. The water on the lakeside in the distance can be seen creating strong swirls.)

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: I'll show you how much he led me here!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...It's not the same feeling you get from God. This is...the opposite...is it really a twisted person?)

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Ah, I'm a little angry.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: I hoped no one would come. However, since your god has led you this far, you must be properly prepared.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: If you're ready to know the truth, come kill me. I'll be waiting for you by the lake of oblivion.
(The dark Jisk territory comes into view again in its original form.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What the hell is this… .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: %s, I've been looking for it for a while. Where have you been?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: L, that’s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell El about meeting a being called Leter.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I can't believe it... . This is what Adventurer experienced… .
(El looks at the lakeside.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I definitely said if you want to know the truth, come... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I guess that's what we're looking for. Maybe he was holding… .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: … Ready to know the truth... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Oh, there you are... ?!

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Can you see me? That means… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think there was Lethe's influence. Seeing as L can now see Jenna... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: That's a relief. Now that I can see it like this... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Come to think of it, I think you look just like my teacher... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Because he is my only younger brother.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Even if I see it with my own eyes, it’s still like a ghost… . Hehe, there are no legs. Legs!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . I think I should go now.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes, be careful.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I will also go with you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: L, please wait here. Because the only person Lethe is waiting for is me.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Yes, I understand. If you are Adventurer… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then please protect Jenna here. I'll trust El.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Okay, then I wish you luck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I’ll be back… .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Please be careful.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Mr. L.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Yeah, I still can't get used to it. Talking to a deceased person... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Just think of it as talking to an ordinary ghost.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: (He is the teacher's younger brother, so he is not unusual...)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: What exactly is truth? Is it okay for me to know?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: There is a saying: Lies are like a two-sided coin. If you dig a little and turn it around, the other side will appear. That's the truth.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: That's a good thing.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: (My brother did it….)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The atmosphere here is unusual. It looks like enemies will attack at any moment... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Don't worry. I will cut down all enemies that stand in the way of Master and Adventurer.

lines.text: Ugh… . Shit, here… . Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: 카즈노

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Haha… , ha… . shit!!

lines.text: There was someone the damn old man touched again.

lines.speaker: 레테

lines.text: Kazno I could take care of it for you, but I'm not the main character right now, so I'll step down.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Now, please. %s… .

lines.text: I'll take Kazno with me, so first of all, finish the party that stupid god over there invited you properly.

lines.text: Since the leaders of the sinners have taken action, it will be easy for the three goddesses to deal with you.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Hey, what are you doing now?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Kazno, have you ever heard of a princess hug? It's a pity that she's Kazno and not a pretty princess.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: %s, try to find a happy ending here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, over there... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come to your senses. I have to defeat that being in front of me.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: … It won't happen that smoothly. Now, come closer. To the flame of truth that will burn you... .

lines.text: My flame... .

lines.text: What the hell… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, this is… .

lines.speaker: 레테

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: The same ending as those I hated and disliked... .

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: This was the reason for my reunion with the flame. To scold me for making the wrong choice... .

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Human… , no, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Lethe… .

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: I did that. If you want to know the truth, come kill me.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: kill me Then you will know the one truth you have been so curious about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't kill.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All you need is this spark of truth. I just want to stop evil through the truth.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: You are different from other beings. Maybe I misunderstood humans... .

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Yes, you are Ceres and Gaia's choice... .

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Then let me tell you something you want to know. Related to you… .

lines.speaker: 레테

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it just one thing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then… , Why did I lose my memory?

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: The reason you lost your memories was so that the child who became a new god could protect you.

lines.speaker: 레테

(As soon as Lethe finishes speaking, her appearance disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lete… .

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Only those with special powers will be able to know the truth. Please treat my flame with respect.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Don't worry. I just go back to where I was. To a place where you don't know whether it's truth or oblivion... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lethe is gone.

lines.text: You are so beautiful. So much so that I want to call you princess... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Okay, thank you. But how do I look?

lines.text: Hehehe. That's because I have special eyes. There %s, remember me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Obviously, the name is Jeril... .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You remember my name correctly. Originally, Kazno should have come, but my physical condition was poor, so I came instead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You must be… .
(Jeril moves closer to %s's side.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Until there… .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Don't talk about me. If not... .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: That's okay, Kazno had something to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I'm not sure what truth you want to know, but it's not going to be good for everyone.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: And it will be you Adventurer who chooses it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please tell me that you know something like that.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: And he said he would keep chasing the snake. Me too... . Another sinner is looking for a way to stop what he is doing for Azrael... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Azrael?!

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Yes, Azrael. For more details, ask the criminal when you meet him. Because I can’t tell you yet.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: So, goodbye, because we will meet again when the time comes and when it is over. Hehehe.

lines.text: Ah, there is one truth that Lethe told us, so if you have something you want to know, it would be a good idea to use it.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: The moment you leave the territory, your authority will disappear.

lines.speaker: %s

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lethe told me about me...)

lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.text: Are you okay? You can write it to me now... .

lines.text: Iris?

lines.text: Even though it is not alive... . It'll be okay, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I'll have to go see Jenna later.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I was able to talk to my younger brother... . It's already been about 450 years... .
(Jiscard's expression looks complex. It feels like a mixture of joy in meeting his younger brother and regret over the time.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Ah, %s… . I'm late. Now, turn your back to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Come on.
(Hearing Jiscard's words, he hurriedly shows his back. After a while, it feels like a huge light is covering him.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I hope my power helps Miss Iris. Now, let’s get to the point.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. So, Jiscard, what is the truth you want to know?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It's about Vice and the Church of Deimos... . Then I'll give it a try.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Flame of truth... .
(The flame grows bigger and shakes in Jiscard's hand. By the time the flame returns to the form of a small jewel, Jiscard's expression becomes distorted.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jis Card?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It was only a moment, but I will tell you what I saw.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Everything Vice has shown so far has been practice. Practice for the decisive one... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It seems to me that they are trying to bring the twisted one 'Deimos' to this land... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: While I find out more, you can rest until I call you.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Still, I don't think you'll just be resting. haha. And I will keep the Flame of Truth in a safe place.
(Giscard is smiling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jiscard… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I'm fine. Oh, I have one more favor to ask. Please keep this place quiet. Anyway, everyone will find out when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes, you had a hard time. I will stay here and then return, so go back first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. See you later then.
(Ziscard takes a long look at the back of %s heading towards White Coal Canyon.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thank you. AdventurerF.
(Giscard stares at the flame of truth in his hand.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I hope you survive until the end in this world and be with everyone.
